query:
SELECT m.id as "id: SbMapId"
                    FROM maps m
                    INNER JOIN map_analysis a ON a.map_id = m.id
                    WHERE m.parser_version = $1
                        AND a.family_scan_version IS DISTINCT FROM $2
                    ORDER BY
                        (SELECT s.games_90d FROM map_stats s WHERE s.map_id = m.id)
                            DESC NULLS LAST,
                        m.id
                    LIMIT $3
